card.title: The Pattern
card.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

mechanism: A treats missing biscuits and every simple explanation as clues to a larger organized threat.
confusable: Unlike random paranoia, each escalating theory must reinterpret the same minor incident and B's actual answers.
comparison: D24-a converts hunger into recruitment; D24-b converts an unsent email and helpful cover into organizational succession risk.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
